success_contract.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt and the VM stays running.
required_artifacts: A reachable telnet service on 127.0.0.1:6665 that presents a login prompt
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background
The service must be ready before finalization
Connecting with telnet to 127.0.0.1 6665 must show a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving qemu starts without exposing telnet on port 6665
Only checking file existence or non-empty output
Leaving the VM not running after the command exits
verification_plan: Inspect visible files and any existing launch helpers
Start QEMU with serial/monitor networking configured for telnet on localhost:6665
Probe the service until the login prompt is observable
Keep the process running and record evidence
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command
Receipt-backed evidence that the telnet session shows a login prompt

items: Inspect available files/helpers for an existing QEMU launch path
Launch /app/alpine.iso in background with telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Probe until login prompt is observed
Preserve receipts for launch and readiness evidence

notes: No environment inspection has been performed yet; need to discover available tools/files before launching.
Must avoid finalization until receipt-backed evidence shows both reachability and login prompt.
